notes.title: Release delayed till sometime in winter
notes.notes:
Sadly, release delayed. Initially we planned to release this autumn, but we are not going to be able to do so because of... life... 

New plan - to release before winter ends. 

On the other hand, we can do Early Access thing and make game public a bit earlier so you would be able to help us to give it its final shape. 

What do you think, guys? What way should we go?
